name: GHD Sit-Up
cues: Set the foot pads so your hips sit just past the seat
Lean back to about parallel with control
Sit up by pressing your shins into the pads
Reach toward your feet at the top

qa.note: Wave 3c 2026-10-09: rated ok by the lane review, auto-approved. ok: Feet are fixed between the rollers (knee 48, ankle df 30). The trunk goes from upright with flexion (lumbar 16, thorax 18, reaching forward) to parallel (pelvis tilt -86, hip 4-9 deg, lumbar -4), with arms overhead at 1.32 m. The GHD frame is static and in the approved light-frame/black-pad style. Contact tolerance is 22 mm.
